questions.stem: What are the three components of a DNA nucleotide?

options.text: An amino acid, a sugar, and a phosphate group
A base, a deoxyribose sugar, and a phosphate group
A base, a ribose sugar, and a fatty acid
A protein, a sugar, and a base

questions.explanation: Each DNA nucleotide is made up of three parts: a nitrogenous base (A, T, C, or G), a deoxyribose sugar, and a phosphate group.
